message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine features a large, smiling human face in the upper right corner, looking down. Below, two massive hands hold an open, thick book with blank pages. A small man in a blue shirt, tie, and trousers stands on the center of the book's pages, holding a briefcase and a folder. He appears diminutive compared to the surrounding elements. The background is a flat, mustard-yellow color.

At the top, text in white and black reads "Di Balik Perluasan Larangan Ekspor Mineral H.86" and "Karya Seni Pilihan Tempo 2022 H.34". The large magazine title "TEMPO" is centered in white, followed by "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Below that, large black text reads "DEBUS OMNIBUS". A paragraph below explains that the palace prepared a government regulation in lieu of law regarding job creation, citing constitutional and democratic defiance on page H.20. The bottom left includes date and price information: "9-15 JANUARI 2023", "RP 50.000", along with a barcode and QR code.
